scripts.build: npm run build -w @bindarr/shared && npm run build -w @bindarr/server && npm run build -w @bindarr/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @bindarr/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev -w @bindarr/server" "npm run dev -w @bindarr/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bindarr/shared && npm run typecheck -w @bindarr/shared && npm run typecheck -w @bindarr/server && npm run typecheck -w @bindarr/web
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run start -w @bindarr/desktop-electron
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @bindarr/desktop-electron
